schema.meaning: the payload structure changed (new schema version / checksum mismatch) and the mapping was not updated
steps: Compare the last two schema versions of the feed and list added/removed/renamed fields.
Check the checksum status of the affected deliveries.
Open a Development ticket with the diff; tell the client a fix is being prepared.

transport.meaning: the data did not arrive or arrived extremely late: upstream source or delivery endpoint problem
steps: Check whether other feeds from the same source also failed (source outage vs endpoint).
Re-trigger the delivery once; if it fails again, escalate to Operations.
Tell the client delivery is delayed and give the next checkpoint time.

content.meaning: data arrived but incomplete: a mapping, artwork, schedule or ID problem inside the payload
steps: Measure which field is missing (artwork, schedule, IDs) using completeness by field.
If artwork: request assets from the client; if schedule: refresh the EPG source.
Escalate to Development only if the mapping itself is wrong.
